Documentation

Everything you need to get CircuitBot running with your Discord team and shipping code faster.

> Quick Start

Get from zero to your first AI-assisted commit in four steps.

01

Download CircuitBot

Grab the desktop app for your OS from the download page. Available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

02

Create a Discord Bot

Set up a bot application in the Discord Developer Portal and copy its token. Takes about 5 minutes.

03

Add Bot to Your Server

Generate an OAuth2 invite URL with the right permissions and add the bot to your Discord server.

04

Start Coding

Launch the desktop app, complete the setup wizard, and @mention your bot in Discord to dispatch your first task.
